reply_text:
**Hold the merge — one critical finding.**

**`src/idle.js:1–4` — Sessions expire after 30 milliseconds, not 30 minutes.** `lastSeen` and `now` are millisecond timestamps, but `IDLE_TIMEOUT` is `30`. Consequently, `sweep()` removes a session just 31 ms after activity, logging out active users on the next sweep. I reproduced this directly.

Recommended fix: use `30 * 60 * 1000` and an inclusive expiry check (`now - session.lastSeen >= IDLE_TIMEOUT`) so expiration starts exactly at 30 minutes.

All **4 existing tests pass**, but they miss this: `test/idle.test.js` checks only “just touched” and “one hour old”; `test/sweep.test.js` checks “just touched” and “two hours old.” Add checks just before, at, and after 30 minutes, plus a recently active session surviving a sweep.

Reviewed the full branch diff against `main` and all source callers. **No code changed.**
